recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit for core reconciliation. No core follow-up is needed unless Citation returns to core; future Citation resource changes belong in the EBM IG, and future societyAffiliation extension changes belong in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-39023 was a Published FHIR-core R5 CDS change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked for society affiliation support for the Citation publication venue and clarification of whether forenameInitials meant middle initials; the final resolution selected a 0..1 string extension for societyAffiliation on Citation.publicationForm.publishedIn and no new middleInitials element because middle initials can be represented with HumanName.given.
initial_application: No core commit directly mentioning FHIR-39023 was found. R5 source contained Citation as an active resource and v5.0.0 Citation retained forenameInitials with a comment explaining initials for all forenames, including middle names. The societyAffiliation piece appears in the FHIR Extension Pack history, where commit 6df8c8a3c3309272aad8f3a1002945c3feb42d2b added StructureDefinition-citation-societyAffiliation.xml.
additional_context: Current core source no longer contains source/citation or an active Citation entry in source/fhir.ini. Commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36 removed Citation from core and changed core clinical reasoning pages to link to the Evidence Based Medicine IG Citation resource. The current Extension Pack definition scopes citation-societyAffiliation to Citation.citedArtifact.publicationForm.publishedIn with a string value.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The current core checkout no longer owns the Citation StructureDefinition, and the extension requested by the final resolution lives in the FHIR Extension Pack, so a core source fix would be out of build scope.
